## Introduction

The goal of this project is to perform a statistical analysis of a High-Fidelity Simulation Aerodynamics Dataset of NACA 0012 and 0021 airfoils. The primary goal of this project is to evaluate how geometric thickness (NACA 0012 vs. NACA 0021) and flow conditions interact to influence load vector fluctuations. An additional analysis will be done to evaluate how simulation mesh resolution (medium, fine) of NACA 0012 affects prediction error relative to experimental wind tunnel benchmarks.

```{r}
# Load Libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(knitr)
```

## Data Tidying

```{r}
cfd_tidy <- bind_rows(
  aoa2705        |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0021", Re = "270k",  AOA = 5,  Mesh = "Fine"),
  aoa27045       |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0021", Re = "270k",  AOA = 45, Mesh = "Fine"),
  aoa27060       |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0021", Re = "270k",  AOA = 60, Mesh = "Fine"),
  aoa2005        |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0021", Re = "2000k", AOA = 5,  Mesh = "Fine"),
  aoa20045       |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0021", Re = "2000k", AOA = 45, Mesh = "Fine"),
  aoa20060       |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0021", Re = "2000k", AOA = 60, Mesh = "Fine"),
  n12_fine_aoa5  |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0012", Re = "2000k", AOA = 5,  Mesh = "Fine"),
  n12_fine_aoa45 |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0012", Re = "2000k", AOA = 45, Mesh = "Fine"),
  n12_fine_aoa60 |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0012", Re = "2000k", AOA = 60, Mesh = "Fine"),
  n12_med_aoa5   |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0012", Re = "2000k", AOA = 5,  Mesh = "Medium"),
  n12_med_aoa45  |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0012", Re = "2000k", AOA = 45, Mesh = "Medium"),
  n12_med_aoa60  |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0012", Re = "2000k", AOA = 60, Mesh = "Medium")
) |>
  mutate(
    Airfoil = factor(Airfoil, levels = c("NACA 0012", "NACA 0021")),
    Re      = factor(Re, levels = c("270k", "2000k")),
    AOA_fac = factor(sprintf("%d°", AOA), levels = c("5°", "45°", "60°")),
    Mesh    = factor(Mesh, levels = c("Medium", "Fine")),
    Config  = sprintf("%s (Re=%s, %s)", Airfoil, Re, Mesh)
  )
```

## Aerodynamics Adjustment and Analysis

```{r}
# Reference scaling factor (Dynamic Pressure * Planform Area)
q_inf_A <- 5750.0

# Compute aerodynamic force vectors, filter startup transient (Time >= 0.25)
cfd_aero <- cfd_tidy |>
  filter(Time >= 0.25) |>
  mutate(
    aoa_rad  = AOA * pi / 180,
    F_x      = Fpx + Fvx,
    F_y      = Fpy + Fvy,
    Fx_total = F_x,
    Fy_total = F_y,
    Fp_mag   = sqrt(Fpx^2 + Fpy^2),
    Fv_mag   = sqrt(Fvx^2 + Fvy^2),
    Skin_Friction_Ratio_Mag = Fv_mag / (Fp_mag + Fv_mag),
    Drag_N   =  F_x * cos(aoa_rad) + F_y * sin(aoa_rad),
    Lift_N   = -F_x * sin(aoa_rad) + F_y * cos(aoa_rad),
    Cd       = Drag_N / q_inf_A,
    Cl       = Lift_N / q_inf_A
  )

aero_summary <- cfd_aero |>
  group_by(Airfoil, Re, AOA, AOA_fac, Mesh, Config) |>
  summarize(
    Mean_Fx = mean(F_x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Fy = mean(F_y, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Skin_Ratio = mean(Skin_Friction_Ratio_Mag, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Cl = mean(Cl, na.rm = TRUE),
    Var_Cl  = var(Cl, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Cl   = sd(Cl, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Cd = mean(Cd, na.rm = TRUE),
    Var_Cd  = var(Cd, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Cd   = sd(Cd, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Mz = mean(Mtz, na.rm = TRUE),
    Var_Mz  = var(Mtz, na.rm = TRUE),
    N_Steps = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


kable(
  aero_summary |>
    select(Airfoil, Re, AOA, Mesh, Mean_Fx, Mean_Fy, Mean_Cl, SD_Cl, Mean_Cd, SD_Cd, N_Steps),
  digits  = 4)
```

## Exploratory Data Analysis Plots

```{r}
# Time-Series Histories
cfd_aero |>
  filter(Mesh == "Fine") |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(F_x, F_y), names_to = "Force_Vector", values_to = "Force_N") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Time, y = Force_N, color = interaction(Airfoil, Re, sep = " | Re="))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.55, alpha = 0.85) +
  facet_grid(AOA_fac ~ Force_Vector, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(title = "Time-Series Histories of Total Force Vectors (F_x and F_y)", color = "Configuration") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Density Distribution Curves
cfd_aero |>
  filter(Mesh == "Fine") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = F_y, fill = interaction(Airfoil, Re, sep = " | Re="), color = interaction(Airfoil, Re, sep = " | Re="))) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ AOA_fac, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(title = "Density Distribution Curves of Total Normal Force (F_y)", fill = "Airfoil & Re", color = "Airfoil & Re") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Pressure Force vs. Viscous Skin Friction Force
cfd_aero |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Fp_mag, y = Fv_mag, color = Config)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ AOA_fac, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  labs(title = "Pressure Force (||F_p||) vs. Viscous Skin Friction Force (||F_v||)", color = "Dataset Configuration") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Skin Friction Contribution Ratio
cfd_aero |>
  ggplot(aes(x = AOA_fac, y = Skin_Friction_Ratio_Mag * 100, fill = Config)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  labs(title = "Skin Friction Contribution Ratio Across Angles of Attack", y = "Skin Friction Ratio (%) [Log10 Scale]", fill = "Dataset Configuration") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Relational Joins & Baseline Error Metrics

```{r}
clean_exp <- function(df, coef_name) {
  if (is.character(df$AOA) || all(is.na(df[[2]]))) {
    lines <- trimws(gsub(",", " ", as.character(df$AOA)))
    lines <- lines[grepl("^[+-]?[0-9]", lines)]
    df <- read.table(text = lines, header = FALSE, col.names = c("AOA", coef_name))
  }
  df |>
    mutate(
      AOA = round(as.numeric(AOA), 1),
      across(all_of(coef_name), as.numeric)
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(AOA)) |>
    distinct(AOA, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

# Combine experimental polars into unified reference dataframe (exp_data)
exp_data <- bind_rows(
  inner_join(clean_exp(exp_n21_cl_270k, "Cl_exp"),     clean_exp(exp_n21_cd_270k, "Cd_exp"),     by = "AOA") |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0021", Re = "270k"),
  inner_join(clean_exp(exp_n21_cl_2000k, "Cl_exp"),    clean_exp(exp_n21_cd_2000k, "Cd_exp"),    by = "AOA") |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0021", Re = "2000k"),
  inner_join(clean_exp(exp_n12_cl_sheldahl, "Cl_exp"), clean_exp(exp_n12_cd_sheldahl, "Cd_exp"), by = "AOA") |> mutate(Airfoil = "NACA 0012", Re = "2000k")
) |>
  mutate(
    Airfoil = factor(Airfoil, levels = c("NACA 0012", "NACA 0021")),
    Re      = factor(Re, levels = c("270k", "2000k"))
  )

# Relational join matching CFD summary cases with experimental polars at AOA = 5, 45, 60
validation_joined <- aero_summary |>
  inner_join(exp_data, by = c("Airfoil", "Re", "AOA")) |>
  mutate(
    Cl_Error     = Mean_Cl - Cl_exp,
    Cd_Error     = Mean_Cd - Cd_exp,
    Cl_Abs_Error = abs(Cl_Error),
    Cd_Abs_Error = abs(Cd_Error),
    Cl_Pct_Error = (Cl_Abs_Error / abs(Cl_exp)) * 100,
    Cd_Pct_Error = (Cd_Abs_Error / abs(Cd_exp)) * 100
  )

kable(
  validation_joined |>
    select(Airfoil, Re, AOA, Mesh, Mean_Cl, Cl_exp, Cl_Error, Mean_Cd, Cd_exp, Cd_Error),
  digits  = 4,
  caption = "Table 2: Relational Join of Time-Averaged CFD Predictions vs. Experimental Wind Tunnel Polars"
)

# Error metrics grouped by Airfoil, Reynolds Number, and Mesh Tier
error_by_config <- validation_joined |>
  group_by(Airfoil, Re, Mesh) |>
  summarize(
    RMSE_Cl = sqrt(mean(Cl_Error^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    MAE_Cl  = mean(Cl_Abs_Error, na.rm = TRUE),
    RMSE_Cd = sqrt(mean(Cd_Error^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    MAE_Cd  = mean(Cd_Abs_Error, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(
  error_by_config,
  digits  = 4,
  caption = "Table 3: Baseline CFD Prediction Error (RMSE & MAE) by Configuration"
)

# Error metrics grouped by Flow Regime (Angle of Attack)
error_by_aoa <- validation_joined |>
  group_by(AOA_fac) |>
  summarize(
    RMSE_Cl     = sqrt(mean(Cl_Error^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    MAE_Cl      = mean(Cl_Abs_Error, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Pct_Cl = mean(Cl_Pct_Error, na.rm = TRUE),
    RMSE_Cd     = sqrt(mean(Cd_Error^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    MAE_Cd      = mean(Cd_Abs_Error, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Pct_Cd = mean(Cd_Pct_Error, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups     = "drop"
  )

kable(
  error_by_aoa,
  digits  = 4,
  caption = "Table 4: Baseline CFD Prediction Error (RMSE & MAE) Across Angles of Attack"
)
```



## Interactive Polar Validation ($C_L$ & $C_D$)

```{r}
exp_long <- exp_data |>
  filter(AOA <= 70) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Cl_exp, Cd_exp), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Exp_Value") |>
  mutate(
    Metric     = ifelse(Metric == "Cl_exp", "Lift Coefficient (Cl)", "Drag Coefficient (Cd)"),
    Exp_Series = sprintf("Exp Benchmark: %s (Re=%s)", Airfoil, Re),
    Hover_Exp  = sprintf("<b>%s</b><br>AOA: %.1f°<br>Benchmark: %.3f", Exp_Series, AOA, Exp_Value)
  )

cfd_long <- validation_joined |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Mean_Cl, Mean_Cd), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "CFD_Value") |>
  mutate(
    SD_Val    = ifelse(Metric == "Mean_Cl", SD_Cl, SD_Cd),
    Exp_Ref   = ifelse(Metric == "Mean_Cl", Cl_exp, Cd_exp),
    Err_Val   = ifelse(Metric == "Mean_Cl", Cl_Error, Cd_Error),
    Metric    = ifelse(Metric == "Mean_Cl", "Lift Coefficient (Cl)", "Drag Coefficient (Cd)"),
    Hover_CFD = sprintf(
      "<b>CFD: %s</b><br>AOA: %d°<br>CFD Mean: %.3f (±%.3f)<br>Exp Benchmark: %.3f<br>Error: %+.3f",
      Config, AOA, CFD_Value, SD_Val, Exp_Ref, Err_Val
    )
  )

p_polar <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = exp_long, aes(x = AOA, y = Exp_Value, color = Exp_Series, group = Exp_Series, text = Hover_Text),
    linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    data = cfd_long, aes(x = AOA, ymin = CFD_Value - SD_Val, ymax = CFD_Value + SD_Val, color = Config),
    width = 1.8, alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = cfd_long, aes(x = AOA, y = CFD_Value, color = Config, text = Hover_CFD),
    size = 3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Metric, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Interactive CFD Predictions vs. Wind Tunnel Benchmark Polars",
    x = "Angle of Attack (Degrees)",
    y = "Aerodynamic Coefficient",
    color = "Legend"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
ggplotly(p_polar_val, tooltip = "text", height = 520) |>
  layout(
    margin = list(b = 110, t = 60),
    legend = list(orientation = "l", x = 0, y = -0.25)
  )

```

## Interactive Time-Series Explorer ($C_L$)

```{r}
cfd_ts_sub <- cfd_aero |>
  group_by(Airfoil, Re, AOA, Mesh) |>
  slice(seq(1, n(), by = 10)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    Hover_Info = sprintf("<b>%s</b><br>AOA: %s<br>Time: %.3f s<br>Cl: %.3f<br>Cd: %.3f", Config, AOA_fac, Time, Cl, Cd)
  )

p_ts <- ggplot(
  cfd_ts_sub,
  aes(x = Time, y = Cl, color = Config, group = Config, text = Hover_Info)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  facet_wrap(~ AOA_fac, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Interactive Unsteady Lift Coefficient (Cl) Explorer",
    x = "Simulation Time (s)",
    y = "Lift Coefficient (Cl)",
    color = "Configuration"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p_ts, tooltip = "text", height = 700) |> 
  layout(legend = list(title = list(text = "<b>Click to Toggle Lines:</b>")))
```
